entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The dark blue single-seat open-wheel race car to which the current cockpit view belongs, with an open cockpit, two black front wheels, and a dark protective frame with a central pillar visible.

entities.name: gray paved racetrack
entities.identification: The gray paved surface extending in a curve ahead of Vehicle A around the grass and runoff area on the left.

entities.name: light blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of light blue sky above the distant view, on both sides of the central pillar of the protective frame.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The driver in Vehicle A, identified by a right hand wearing a dark blue glove and a right forearm covered by a blue sleeve; prominent white printed text is on the back of the hand.

entities.name: multi-button steering wheel
entities.identification: The black irregularly shaped steering wheel held by Person A, with colored buttons, circular knobs, and white markings visible.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low dark open-wheel race car ahead of Vehicle A, initially near the left edge of the image and subsequently farther inward on the left.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The red-and-white segmented curb on the inside of the left turn, beside the green paved runoff.

entities.name: grass beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low green to yellow-green grassy area outside the racetrack surface and adjacent to the green pavement.

entities.name: trees beside the racetrack
entities.identification: Clusters of trees distributed around the outside of the road, with uneven green crowns.

entities.name: racetrack safety barrier
entities.identification: The low continuous barrier extending around the outside of the racetrack below the mesh fence, whose visible surface in this clip is primarily green advertising panels.

entities.name: racetrack metal mesh fence
entities.identification: The protective fence above the green barrier, composed of spaced vertical posts, thin horizontal lines, and a mesh enclosure surface.

entities.name: tiered grandstand
entities.identification: The long seating structure extending horizontally behind the mesh fence and rising tier by tier.

entities.name: colored paved runoff area
entities.identification: The flat green pavement outside the road edge on the left side of the image, with a yellow patch visible in the middle section.

entities.name: racetrack sign
entities.identification: The long horizontal green advertising panels arranged along the barrier around the outside of the road.

entities.name: distant hills
entities.identification: The pale gray-blue outline of low, gently rolling hills behind the trees and mesh fence around the outside of the road.

entities.name: spectators beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The distant spectators distributed in groups across the grandstand and nearby areas, labeled collectively as a background group.
